data.name: AlIghlal
data.gender_notes: AlIghlal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghlal' which means 'to be victorious'. This name symbolizes triumph and success in life, as well as being a reminder of the ultimate victory that awaits believers in the Hereafter. The name AlIghlal carries the meaning “The Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlIghlal usually hope their child will grow to embody the victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of victory in the battlefield of life and in the afterlife.
data.etymology: AlIghlal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlIghlal total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
